initialVerificationIssues: The sandbox prevented the local Playwright server from starting; browser checks passed after running outside that restriction.
Eight CLI assertions could not capture subprocess output in the sandbox. The unchanged full unit suite passed outside the restriction.
One new browser test initially fetched the recording before asynchronous generation completed. The test now waits for the ready response; all cases passed.
limitations: Initial match generation and audio preparation still take time; no latency benchmark or guaranteed completion time.
Audio and pitch synchronization is approximate within each passage, not word-aligned.
New match creation produces a new match; existing sessions are reused by ID, not by seed alone.
Speech budgets may prevent preparing very dense or long recordings in full.
A reserved synthesis finishes under the provider timeout after a viewer disconnects and remains cached.
Subjective voice quality and professional football realism are not measured by these checks.
